construction.implementation_origin: Original implementation authored for this isolated build

shared_schema.input: Strict version=1 envelope: fixture_label string, documents[{id,text}], fields[{name,label,required}], queries[{id,text,fields}], top_k integer 1..20
shared_schema.output: Input envelope plus extraction and findings arrays and status=ok
shared_schema.source: {document_id,start,end,quote}; half-open Unicode character offsets into original text
shared_schema.extraction: Per-document fields map to arrays of {value,source}; missing_fields includes name and required; complete reflects required fields only
shared_schema.findings: Per-query query_id, expanded_from [{field,value,source}], status found/no_evidence, passages [{text,score,query_terms,field_terms,source}]
shared_schema.validation: One validate function enforces each phase and verifies intermediate and final results against deterministic canonical source-grounded calculations

cross_stage_handoffs: extract validates the input, preserves documents/schema/queries, adds extracted matches and missing reports, then validates the handoff
research accepts only validated extraction envelopes; selected extracted field values supply lexical expansion terms across the corpus
research preserves extraction provenance, cites every returned passage exactly, and validates the final envelope

behavior.extraction: Case-insensitive exact label before first colon on a line; trimmed nonempty string values; all repeated matches retained
behavior.retrieval: Nonempty trimmed lines; Unicode casefolded word tokens; score=2*distinct query overlap + distinct extracted-value overlap; positive scores only
behavior.ordering: Descending score, then input document order, then source start offset
behavior.missing_fields: Missing required fields mark that document incomplete but do not stop research; optional missing fields also reported
behavior.errors: Invalid schema, malformed/duplicate-key/nonfinite JSON, read and decode failures return one status=error JSON object and exit 2
behavior.limits: 100 documents, 100000 characters per document, 1000000 total characters, 50 fields, 30 queries, top_k up to 20
behavior.ancillary_file: docs\My_prompt.txt is the mandatory prompt audit log, separate from the four deliverables

included: Integrated deterministic extraction and cited lexical retrieval
Exact source spans, required/optional missing-field reporting
Shared validation, CLI JSON errors and unittest coverage
excluded: Live models, injected model hooks, networks and third-party packages
OCR, PDF parsing, typed value coercion and semantic extraction
Generated summaries, truth verification, enterprise indexing and deployment

test_outcomes.cli_example: passed: one JSON object with status=ok, exit 0
test_outcomes.error_cli: passed: missing file and usage errors return status=error, exit 2
